name: reading-progress
title: Reading Progress
description: A reading progress bar: a 2px ink baseline with an ink fill-lines bar sitting on it (G7), in whole pixels; the bar shares the baseline's outer edge and grows inward, 4px of solid ink at rest and 6px with a paper speed line through it while the reader scrolls or the value changes. Measures the scroll of a target element (its own scroll, or how far the window has moved through it) or of the window, with requestAnimationFrame, cleaned up on unmount; or takes a controlled value (then the width moves in steps). Positions: fixed to the top or bottom edge of the viewport, or inline in the flow. In manga reading order (data-reading="rtl") it fills from the right. Optional value text ("42 %" or "Page 3 / 8") on paper, never on the lines. role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow/min/max and aria-valuetext. Reduced motion: no motion, the value still updates. Also exports useScrollProgress(target).
docs: Import from "@/components/manga/reading-progress". Without value it measures the window (or target); with value it is controlled, e.g. value={ratio * 100} from ReaderStrip's onProgress.

meta.tagline: How far the reader has gone, in speed lines.
meta.usage:
import { ReadingProgress } from "@/components/manga/reading-progress"

<ReadingProgress position="top" />
<ReadingProgress value={37.5} showValue valueText="Page 3 / 8" />

props.name: value
props.description: 0-100, controlled. Leave out to measure the scroll.

props.name: target
props.description: Element whose scroll progress is measured. Default: the window.

props.name: position
props.description: Fixed to that edge of the viewport, or in the flow.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Shows the value as a small text.

props.name: valueText
props.description: Text for the value, e.g. "Page 3 / 8"; also aria-valuetext.
